messages:
Maria Chen: Deploy finished for release/serve-v3 -> prod (us-west-2). :rocket: Running smoke sweep now — health, embeddings, latency tail. Will post quick checklist results.

deploy-bot: Deployment succeed: release/serve-v3 to prod (us-west-2) by @maria. Duration: 4m 12s. CI: green. Logs: https://ci.example/release/serve-v3

Dean Patel: Copy — I'll run the API sanity curl + embedding check. Ping me if you want rollback ready.

Olga Smirnova: Running health checks against LB now: 200s on /health across all zones.

Kai Nguyen: Quick perf sniff: tail p50/p95 on generation-router for last 10m: p50 ~ 46ms, p95 ~ 318ms. No big jumps so far.

Dean Patel: Embedding smoke: ran 3 sample vectors, cosine results stable vs canary. curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.prod.redwood/v1/embeddings -d '{"input": "test embedding"}'
```
returned 2 vectors, norms look ok.

Maria Chen: Can someone check the KV cache hit rate? I expect warm caches from the pre-warm job.

Olga Smirnova: KV cache hit: 92% on avg across pods. Warmup pods are healthy. Error rate 0.02% (mostly 404s for deleted keys).

Kai Nguyen: Noticed an increase in tail on a single pod id=pod-7f8c, investigating. Snapshot of logs:
```
[2026-03-15T18:07:12Z] WARN: slow-kv-fetch duration=420ms key=ctx-abc123
[2026-03-15T18:07:13Z] INFO: kv-retry succeeded
```
Might be transient I/O on that host.

Dean Patel: I'm running a light rewrite check (canary fallback) — failover route tested, request switched to next-region model and returned fine.

Maria Chen: OK, sounds good. Rollback readiness: @Dean has the rollback playbook and can trigger the previous tag if we hit >0.5% errors or sustained p95 > 1s for 5m. Please escalate in thread if anything crosses thresholds.

deploy-bot: Alert rule check: error-rate alert (threshold 0.5%) currently at 0.12%. p95-generation alert (threshold 1s) 0.32s.

Olga Smirnova: FYI pushed a small patch to infra to increase request queue timeout from 15s -> 20s for this rollout; it's a conservative safety net. No restarts.

Maria Chen: Thanks — let's keep monitoring for 30m. If anything looks flaky, add logs + stacktraces in this thread and we'll decide rollback or patch. :eyes:

Kai Nguyen: Adding a quick watchlist dashboard: https://grafana.example/d/abc/smoke-sweep?orgId=1

Dean Patel: All clear from my side for now. Will re-check in 10 minutes and again at 30.

Maria Chen: Perfect — closing the immediate sweep, will update if we need action. :white_check_mark:
